_doc: The registration the local dashboard asks for once per data folder (PRIVACY.md "Registration"), read by agentcake/registration.py and served by GET /api/register so that the card checks what AgentCake checks. The card's words and the version of its text are in the pages (web/src/lib/registration.ts): the page sends the version of the text it showed. email_pattern is the HTML standard's valid e-mail address (WHATWG input type=email) with at least one dot after the @, written so that both Python's re and JavaScript's RegExp read it the same; email_max_chars is the longest address SMTP carries (RFC 5321 section 4.5.3.1.3). send_timeout_s bounds the one request to register_url (defaults.json). delete_contact is where to write to have a registration deleted, as PRIVACY.md says.
